# Tasks — Production Readiness (Approach B)
*Generated by create_tasks on 2026-04-06*

## Objective
Make Keiro PWA ready for public launch with proper icons, meta tags, privacy policy, code splitting, fail-loud error handling, security headers, and offline UX.

## Scope
- **In Scope**: Icon generation, PWA manifest fix, meta tags, robots.txt, privacy policy page, React.lazy code splitting, Vite manual chunks, fail-loud error handling (ErrorBoundary, Settings, sync, offline), CSP + security headers in Vercel
- **Out of Scope**: Sentry integration, Capacitor/App Store, custom domain, i18n, analytics provider

## Architecture Context

### Where This Fits
- PWA config lives in `apps/web/vite.config.ts` (Workbox + manifest)
- HTML shell is `apps/web/index.html` (meta tags, icon links)
- All routes are in `apps/web/src/App.tsx` (currently static imports)
- Error boundary wraps the entire app in `App.tsx` → `ErrorBoundary`
- Vercel config is `apps/web/vercel.json` (currently SPA rewrites only)
- Content JSON is imported via `packages/content/src/index.ts`

### Technical Approach
- Generate PNGs from existing `favicon.svg` using a one-off Node script with `sharp`
- Use `React.lazy()` + `Suspense` for all 15 page routes
- Use Vite `rollupOptions.output.manualChunks` to split vendor/supabase/content
- Create `useOnline` hook (minimal, actually wired into app shell this time)
- Expose sync errors via a reactive state on SyncService, consumed by app shell

### Key Decisions
- Skip Sentry (no paid plan) — ErrorBoundary logs to console.error only
- og:image uses the 512px icon (no custom social image for now)
- Privacy policy is a static React page (not a PDF or external link)
- Offline banner shown in app shell (AuthHandler level), not per-page

### Phase 4: Code Splitting

#### [4.1] Lazy-Load All Page Routes
- [ ] **4.1.1** Convert all 15+ page imports in `apps/web/src/App.tsx` to `React.lazy()` with `Suspense` fallback using existing `LoadingPage` component
  - **Produces**: Lazy-loaded route chunks (one per page)
  - **Consumed by**: React Router `<Routes>` in App.tsx
  - **Replaces**: Static imports of all pages at top of App.tsx
  - [ ] All page imports use `React.lazy(() => import(...))`
  - [ ] `<Suspense fallback={<LoadingPage />}>` wraps `<Routes>`
  - [ ] App still renders all routes correctly (no broken navigation)

#### [4.2] Configure Vite Manual Chunks
- [ ] **4.2.1** Add `rollupOptions.output.manualChunks` to `apps/web/vite.config.ts` to split vendor, supabase, and content into separate chunks
  - **Produces**: Multiple smaller JS chunks instead of one large bundle
  - **Consumed by**: Browser (loads chunks on demand)
  - **Replaces**: `chunkSizeWarningLimit: 1500` suppression (remove it)
  - [ ] `vendor` chunk: react, react-dom, react-router
  - [ ] `supabase` chunk: @supabase/supabase-js
  - [ ] Content split by level (N5/N4/N3 JSON data in separate chunks)
  - [ ] `chunkSizeWarningLimit` line removed
  - [ ] Build completes without chunk size warnings
